description: This Java source file defines a final class RetrieveFeatureLiveCommandAnswerBuilderImpl that extends a generic abstract builder class and implements an interface for building responses to a retrieve feature command in a live signals context. It includes methods for creating response objects and handling errors related to feature accessibility.
